function.name: get_daily_prompt
function.description: Fetch the daily planning prompt text for a given date from Chronos. Uses GET /daily-prompt with Authorization: Bearer <CHRONOS_API_TOKEN>.

date.description: Date to fetch in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: list_events
function.description: List events in a date range from Chronos. Uses GET /events with Authorization: Bearer <CHRONOS_API_TOKEN>.

start_date.description: Filter events using this date as a lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Filter events using this date as an upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: list_tasks
function.description: List tasks from Chronos. Uses GET /tasks with Authorization: Bearer <CHRONOS_API_TOKEN>.
